map.流速与雷诺数计算 使用指南: Flow velocity and Reynolds number calculation user guide
map.输入明渠断面参数，用曼宁公式求平均流速，并依据雷诺数 Re 判定流态（层流/过渡: Enter open-channel section parameters, use Manning formula for average velocity, and by Reynolds number Re judge flow regime (laminar/transition/turbulent), by Froude number Fr judge subcritical/supercritical, aiding flow regime identification and channel design in hydraulics.
map.曼宁流速 v = (1/n)·R^(2/3)·J^(1/2)；雷诺数 Re =: Manning velocity v = (1/n)*R^(2/3)*J^(1/2); Reynolds number Re = v*d / nu; Froude number Fr = v / sqrt(g*R)
map.明渠平均流速用曼宁公式由水力半径 R、糙率 n 与水力坡度 J 求得。流态判定分: Open-channel average velocity uses Manning formula from hydraulic radius R, roughness n and hydraulic gradient J. Flow regime has two layers: Reynolds number Re with characteristic length and kinematic viscosity distinguishes laminar (Re<500), transition and turbulent; Froude number Fr distinguishes subcritical (Fr<1), critical and supercritical (Fr>1). Combined they identify flow state, aiding channel anti-scour design and regime analysis.
map.管内流速配合 Re 判流态。: Pipe velocity combined with Re to judge flow regime.
map.层流与紊流选不同损失公式。: Laminar and turbulent flow use different loss formulas.
map.临界流速校核防沉积或冲刷。: Check critical velocity to prevent deposition or scouring.
map.：v=0.8、D=0.014、ν=0.0005（示意）→ Re=0.8×0.01: : v=0.8, D=0.014, nu=0.0005 (illustrative) -> Re = 0.8*0.014/0.0005 = 22.4, low; water nu~1e-6 gives Re=11200, turbulent.
map.：Re=2000 为层流上限，超过即转紊流，损失规律随之改变。: : Re=2000 is the laminar upper limit; exceeding it turns turbulent, loss law changes accordingly.
map.惯性力与黏性力之比，决定流态与损失规律。: Ratio of inertial to viscous force, determining flow regime and loss law.
map.层流沿程损失∝v、紊流∝v^1.75~2，公式与安全余量不同。: Laminar friction loss is proportional to v, turbulent to v^1.75-2; formulas and safety margins differ.
